title: security & compliance review prep - 1:1 notes
content:
Goal: prep for 1:1 with Aaron (security lead) to align on audit readiness items and vendor risk queue. Focus areas: SOC2 in-scope controls, ISO gap list, vendor evidence collection, and timeline for auditor kickoff (target: May 2026).

High-level status (quick mental checklist)
- SOC2: scoping done; most policies in Confluence but evidence collection lagging.
- ISO27001: gap assessment largely complete; need to map corrective actions to owners.
- Vendor risk: top 10 vendors reviewed; 3 flagged for follow-up (DatamoverX, TelemetryHub, ThirdPartyAI).
- Controls automation: some evidence auto-collected (OKTA, GCP IAM logs), but manual artifacts remain (runbooks, interview notes).

Questions I want to raise in the 1:1
1) Auditor selection: do we have preferred auditor shortlist? (Priya likely has contacts) — ask Aaron if we should re-run RFQ or go with previous firm.
2) Evidence ownership: can we formalize per-control owner list by next week? propose a RACI doc with owners and backup reviewers.
3) Vendor risk deadlines: can procurement push PO/VSA renewals so updated security docs arrive before audit?
4) ISO: which corrective actions are blocking certification and who will be the exec approver for compensating controls?
5) Data residency question: confirm whether Private customers with on-prem still require us to include private-deploy package in scoping.

Notes / talking points
- Timeline: propose internal readiness review mid-April, remediation window April 20–May 10, external auditor kickoff week of May 12. That gives ~2.5 months to collect evidence and close high-priority gaps.
- Evidence matrix: highlight the biggest gaps — annual penetration test report (last done 2024, need 2025 test or exception), change management logs for model deployment (needs to show approvals), and vendor SOC2 reports (we are missing DatamoverX full report).
- Automated pulls: work with infra SRE to add GCS bucket ACL exports to the evidence pipeline (ticket to SRE: INF-211).
- Interviews: schedule 30–45 min sessions with owners for critical controls: identity management (Sam), change mgmt (Eng Release), incident response (Ops on-call).

Vendor risk quick notes
- DatamoverX: data transfer/storage - missing latest SOC2 Type II; procurement said vendor has a draft but not finalized. Risk = high (has access to PII). Action: request formal attestation + encryption config screenshots. Owner: Priya. Target: 2026-03-10.
- TelemetryHub: telemetry aggregator - uses 3rd party subprocessor in EU. Risk = medium. Action: confirm SCCs and subprocessor list; update vendor profile. Owner: Aaron. Target: 2026-03-17.
- ThirdPartyAI: model provider for embeddings - remote code execution risk assessment needed. Risk = high/uncertain. Action: schedule security review with Applied ML and get dev-sec signoff. Owner: Sam Lee + Applied ML. Target: 2026-03-24.

Action items to propose in 1:1 (with suggested owners/dates)
- Create per-control owner RACI and publish Confluence table (Owner: Maya / Aaron review) — draft by 2026-02-27, finalize 2026-03-05.
- Open evidence collection tickets in SEC tracker for all in-scope controls (Owner: Maya) — create by 2026-02-25.
- Reach out to DatamoverX to request SOC2 2025 report + encryption screenshots (Owner: Priya) — due 2026-03-10.
- Add GCS ACL export to evidence pipeline (Owner: INF-SRE, contact: Sam Lee) — ticket INF-211 created; aim 2026-03-12.
- Schedule control-owner interviews: identities, change mgmt, incident response, backup and recovery (Owner: Maya) — schedule invites by 2026-02-28.
- RFQ for auditor: confirm shortlist and procurement approach (Owner: Aaron / Priya) — decision by 2026-03-08.

Risk / blockers I should call out
- Resource availability in April (many on vacation windows) — may compress remediation time. Suggest we lock key owners now.
- Missing third-party artifacts (esp. DatamoverX) — could push audit scope or require compensating controls.
- Model lifecycle evidence: need to standardize deployment change logs from Serving Runtime team. Might require a small work item to add structured audit logs.

Prep script for the 1:1 (agenda)
- Quick status (3–4 min) — what’s green/red?
- Timeline & proposed auditor kickoff (3 min)
- Vendor risk highlights + ask for procurement leverage (6 min)
- RACI & evidence collection plan review (8 min)
- Confirm interview schedule and automation tickets (5 min)
- Decisions needed / asks from Aaron (5 min): approver for compensating controls, resource commitments for April, auditor shortlist preference

Back-of-envelope items to capture here
- Evidence count estimate: ~120 artifacts across controls (API logs, policies, runbooks, screenshots). Prior audit had ~95 but we tightened scope.
- Priority controls to get first: change mgmt, access control, encryption at rest, incident response.

Loose notes / scratch thoughts (keep short)
- Could we re-scope some low-risk controls to demo rather than full artifact set? saves time but needs auditor buy-in.
- Consider quick tabletop incident for April to generate IR evidence (ops exercise).
- Need a one-pager for execs summarizing: status, top 3 risks, ask (budget/time).

Next steps after 1:1
- Update Confluence control matrix with agreed RACI and deadlines.
- Triage vendor artifacts and escalate procurement where needed.
- Create calendar invites for interviews and confirm attendees.

Links to reference (copy/paste into meeting)
- Confluence SOC2 control matrix: https://redwood-infer.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/123456789/SOC2+Control+Matrix
- Internal SEC tracker board: SEC-432
- Security-audit repo (evidence scripts): https://github.com/redwood-inference/security-audit/pull/98

Personal reminders
- Bring list of 3 escalate candidates if vendor artifacts don’t land on time.
- Prep one slide for exec 1:1 that succinctly states ask.
- Follow up with Priya on auditor contacts before meeting with Aaron.

-- end of notes --
